name: Perplexity Enterprise Pro
pros: Consumer product quality with enterprise data controls
Admin dashboard for inventory and governance
files: Web retrieval plus document uploads where supported.
value: Extends the Perplexity citing-answer model to enterprise requirements: SSO, admin controls, data retention controls, and prompts not used for training. The underlying product is the same, with the security envelope that regulated organizations need.
engine: Same as Perplexity AI: multi-model retrieval-augmented generation with citations.

pricing.includes: SSO, admin controls, data retention controls, no training opt-in

quality: Same quality characteristics as the consumer product. Citations require the same read-the-source discipline.
tagline: The enterprise tier of the citing answer engine, with data controls and SSO.
use_cases: Organization-wide research capability with audit and admin oversight
Replacing ad-hoc web research with a citable, policy-compliant tool
Embedding sourced answers in internal workflows via the API
governance_note: Same evidentiary point as the consumer product, now under admin control. The admin dashboard tells you which seats are active and what the usage looks like, which matters for the AI inventory. Citations are still leads, not evidence, and that rule does not change with the tier.
training_optout: Enterprise Pro explicitly excludes customer data from model training. Verify the current contract terms.
